name: tunnerez noz
text: tunnerez noz is a Breton death-omen figure related to the washer at the ford tradition. MacKillop reads the form as a probable Breton recasting of the death omen known across the broader Celtic oral record. The principal record of that washer tradition sits under washer at the ford.

attributes.attribute: Breton death-omen figure; probable instance of the washer-at-the-ford type

okr.objective: tunnerez noz is a MacKillop signpost to washer at the ford.
key_results: Cites washer at the ford as the canonical headword.
Breton instance of the death-omen tradition.
